svg.title: Three model roles with application-controlled tools
svg.desc: The application routes instruction following and writing to Grok 4.3, reasoning and tool selection to Grok 4.20, and analysis of collected evidence to Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent. Python validates tool requests before execution. Multi-Agent receives evidence, without direct access to connectors.
